title: Import existing rentals
subtitle: Maintenance tool to quickly migrate rentals you've been tracking manually or in another system.

step1.title: 1. Prepare the CSV file
step1.description: Download the template, fill in one row per rental, and upload the file. If the customer already exists (same ID number) or the asset already exists (same name), it's reused; otherwise it's created automatically with the row's data.
step1.requiredText: customerFullName, customerIdentityNumber, assetName, startDate, endDate, totalPrice.
step1.newAssetLabel: Only if the asset is new:
step1.newAssetText: assetCategoryName (required in that case), assetBasePrice, assetStock, assetRentalType (Daily/Weekly/Biweekly/Monthly/Annual).
step1.statusText: Active, Completed, or Overdue (defaults to Active).

step2.title: 2. Upload and review
step2.dropzone: Upload a CSV file to see the preview here.

toast.parseError: We couldn't read the file. Make sure it's a valid CSV.
toast.noRows: The file has no rows to import.
toast.rowsLoaded: {{count}} row(s) loaded. Review the preview before importing.
toast.importError: We couldn't process the import. Try again.
